theme.title: Shaq and Kobe's three-peat
theme.subtitle: Los Angeles Lakers, 2000–2002
theme.recap: Shaquille O'Neal dominated three straight Finals, and the 2001 Lakers lost just once in the playoffs.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1999–2000 Lakers win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They posted winning streaks of 11, 16, and 19 en route to a 67–15 record

funFacts.text: The Lakers hired Phil Jackson shortly after the Spurs swept them out of the previous postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Twenty-four days after being swept by the eventual league champion, the Lakers signed Phil Jackson as head coach

funFacts.text: Jackson installed the triangle offense around Shaquille O'Neal and Kobe Bryant, borrowing the system from his Bulls years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jackson, famous for coaching Michael Jordan and the six-time champion Chicago Bulls, would build his triangle offense

funFacts.text: This was the Lakers' inaugural season playing home games at Staples Center, their newly opened arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Another huge change for the Lakers was that it was their inaugural season at the Staples Center

questions.prompt: Shaquille O'Neal averaged how many points in the 2000 Finals?
questions.context: 2000 NBA Finals · six games vs Indiana

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: putting up 38.0 points, 16.7 rebounds, and 2.7 blocks per game

funFacts.text: Indiana was making its first NBA Finals appearance, with Larry Bird coaching the Pacers against Los Angeles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This marked Indiana's first NBA Finals appearance

funFacts.text: Shaq swept regular-season MVP, All-Star Game MVP and Finals MVP honors in the same calendar year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: one of only three players to win NBA MVP, NBA All-Star Game MVP and NBA Finals MVP awards in the same year

funFacts.text: The Lakers' victory ended a championship drought stretching back to the Showtime era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: to win their first NBA championship since 1988 and their twelfth overall

questions.prompt: Allen Iverson handed the 2001 Lakers their only playoff loss in Finals Game 1. How many points did he score?
questions.context: 2001 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Los Angeles

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iverson scored 48 points along with 5 steals

funFacts.text: Iverson's overtime step-back over Tyronn Lue produced the famous image of him stepping over his fallen defender.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he stepped over Lue after hitting the shot

funFacts.text: Philadelphia survived despite trailing early, after Los Angeles opened with a long unanswered scoring run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Scoring 16 straight points, the Lakers took a 21–9 lead

funFacts.text: Dikembe Mutombo's interior work helped Philadelphia hang on as a late missed shot sent the game to overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: when Dikembe Mutombo missed two free throws and Eric Snow's desperation three-pointer

questions.prompt: How many free throws did Shaquille O'Neal attempt in Game 2 of the 2000 Finals?
questions.note: 39, an NBA record at the time. He made 18.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Shaq shot 39 free throws, making only 18, an NBA record for most free throws attempted

funFacts.text: Kobe Bryant sprained his ankle and left the game in the opening quarter, forcing the Lakers to adjust immediately.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kobe Bryant left the game in the 1st quarter due to a sprained ankle and did not return

funFacts.text: Ron Harper replaced the injured Bryant and supplied important scoring in the Lakers' victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ron Harper went in for Bryant and scored 21 points for the game

funFacts.text: A late Shaq pass became a Robert Horry layup and foul shot that protected Los Angeles's narrow lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he passed to Robert Horry who converted not only the layup, but the foul shot

questions.prompt: In Game 2 of the 2001 Finals, Shaq had 28 points, 20 rebounds, nine assists and how many blocks?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: O'Neal finished with 28 points, 20 rebounds, nine assists, and eight blocks

funFacts.text: Phil Jackson challenged Shaq to attack shots before tipoff after the center failed to record a block in the opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Don't be afraid to block a shot!

funFacts.text: Philadelphia's poor fourth-quarter foul shooting blunted its comeback despite getting close to the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 6 of 16 foul shooting in the fourth quarter put them behind permanently

funFacts.text: Bryant opened the rematch aggressively, while other Lakers outside the star duo struggled from the field.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: all the Lakers besides Bryant and O'Neal were shooting only at 27%
